cells.tense: Right now the mind is settling on its own, and the people near you get the benefit.
cells.act: walk toward what connects, leaving what does not
cells.ask: Pick a connection that matters and go a layer deeper than the easy exchange. Say what you actually think, ask what you have been leaving alone, and stay for whatever comes back.
cells.core:
When something between you and someone else gets loud, you can sit in it without adding to it. You feel the pull and stay level, and the people near you steady themselves off that. That is the shape of this thing working: not holding the peace for them, just being restful enough that they can find their own.

The next stretch is toward a connection rather than around it. Choose one and go a layer deeper than the easy exchange. Say the thing you actually think. Ask the question you have been leaving alone. Leaving the hollow version behind is the point. It will not be comfortable, and comfort is not what it is for.
cells.sheetLine: You keep the peace. You are free to go deeper than that.
cells.verb: resting the mind until it finds its level
cells.place: where you feel with people and stay level with them

cells.tense: From here you are already bracing for how this connection might go wrong, and the bracing is doing the talking.
cells.act: keep the heading when it is contested
cells.ask: Choose a tie you want to keep and hold your heading once when it pushes at you — no pre-correction, no softening it into something easier to carry.
cells.core:
Somewhere in the connections that matter, you are running the next difficult conversation in advance, and running it changes how you show up now. The other person meets a version of you that has already decided something, and they have not been given their chance in it. Watchful is not the same as present, and the difference is starting to show.

Take one direction and stand in it instead of anticipating every other. Pick a tie you chose on purpose. When it pushes, keep your heading once — no pre-correction, no softening into something easier to hold. The determination has to come from how you actually feel about them, not from the shape you have been rehearsing.
cells.sheetLine: You decided how it goes before you got there.

cells.tense: You left this connection at a door you have already walked past, and part of you is still standing there.
cells.act: hold the cloud of possible feeling without picking yet
cells.ask: Let a few possible feelings about someone gather and sit with them, choosing none. No decision, no next step — just let what might be felt be felt a while.
cells.core:
In the place where connection runs, you have stepped out and the room is emptier for it. Feeling that could be felt stays unnamed, and what is there between you and someone else goes on the surface, and you let it. The connection is still yours to pick up. It is just not being picked up, and you can feel which one.

Push will not do it. Let several feelings about a person gather and sit with them without choosing one — curiosity, fondness, the thing you keep not saying. No commitment, no deciding. Being drawn is enough to restart it, and it restarts before you choose anything.
cells.sheetLine: Something is waiting to be felt. You do not have to reach yet.

cells.tense: The connections near you hold because you keep them level, and if anyone asked, you would say you were not doing anything.
cells.act: leave the hollow ritual for the living one
cells.ask: Take a routine that has gone hollow between you and someone — the regular call, the standing thing — and either skip it once or put the true sentence into it.
cells.core:
You are the reason several people in your life stay level with each other. You feel the room and adjust, mostly without saying so, and most of the time you would tell it as if nothing much happened. The people you steady have noticed the work whether or not you have named it, and the way you describe it has been small.

Drop the sealed version and say it as a thing you do. Pick one routine that has gone hollow between you and someone — the catch-up with nothing in it — and either skip it once or put the true sentence into it. What you do keeps working either way. This only puts the person holding it back inside the picture.
